scientific_integrity: The infinite nonattainment proof is symbolic; exact-rational finite-prefix checks are corroboration only. The finding concerns Boolean inputs and modal depth one, with a sharp depth-two counterexample, not all depths or unrestricted fuzzy atomic inputs.
scientific_limitations: No universal characterization of every-depth witnessability is proved.
Prior equivalent statements may exist under different descriptions of accessibility-grade spectra.
Independent validation and audit have not been performed.
title: Boolean-input Gödel witnessability: an exact one-step criterion and a depth-two obstruction
